Name: (CP) Misa Amane (Death Note) - Haley Portrait
Author: haae1020
Description:
[b][size=5]Important[/size][/b]
This mod includes the default and beach portraits, but does not currently support winter portraits.

[size=5]Description[/size]
This mod replaces Hailey's portraits with Misa Amane from Death Note.
Only the portrait artwork is changed. All in-game functionality, dialogue, schedules, events, and gameplay remain completely unchanged.
This is a visual retexture only and has no impact on gameplay.

[size=5]Installation[/size]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
. Download this mod and decompress it.
4. Place the uncompressed folder in the Stardew Valley mode folder.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

[size=5]Features[/size]
Replaces Hailey's portraits with custom Misa Amane artwork.
Changing Hayley's portrait to the appearance of Mass.
Content Patcher was used for safe and compatible portrait replacement.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
SMAPI (latest version recommended)
Content Patcher
